title: Extinguish the Fire of Doubt
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 22
summary: Doubt is treated here as an inner fire, not a refined personality trait. Wandering does not put it out; Guru-centered living does.
whyItMatters: It speaks directly to second-guessing, spiritual tourism, indecision, and the exhaustion of circling without landing.
takeaway: Stop circling and let Guru's word take residence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharame bhaeh na vijhavai je bhavai dhisa(n)tar dhes ||
lines.translation: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar mail na utarai dhirag jeevan dhirag ves ||
lines.translation: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hor kitai bhagat na hoviee bin satigur ke upadhes ||1||
lines.translation: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa kahiaa man vasai haumai tirasanaa maar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man maanak niramol hai raam naam pat pai ||
lines.translation: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat har paieeaai gurmukh har liv lai ||
lines.translation: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap giaa sukh paiaa mil salalai salal samai ||2||
lines.translation: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har har naam na chetio su aaugun aavai jai ||
lines.translation: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis satagur purakh na bheTio su bhaujal pachai pachai ||
lines.translation: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: eih maanak jeeau niramol hai iau kauddee badhalai jai ||3||
lines.translation: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)naa satagur ras milai se poore purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mil bhaujal la(n)gheeaai dharageh pat paravaan ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale dhun upajai sabadh neesaan ||4||22||
lines.translation: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||

structure: Names doubt as a fire that travel and outer change cannot extinguish.
Shows the actual turn: Guru's word within, selfishness reduced, saint company embraced.
Ends by describing what settled doubt looks like: radiance, approval, and inward music.
